failures.prompt: Ask someone to speak more slowly.
Explain that a situation is unfair.
Explain that a product has a warranty.
Ask whether tax is included in the total price.
Ask to exchange an item for another.
Ask someone to open an app.
Ask whether software needs an update.
Tell someone to stop because something is unsafe.

interpretation.comparison_to_optimized_256: The held-out score is lower than the optimized frozen 256-task benchmark, showing that the earlier 100% practical result does not generalize unchanged to this prospective battery.
interpretation.strength: The system still completes 354 of 384 held-out tasks under the frozen scoring law, with controlled paraphrase carrying a large share of coverage.
interpretation.weakness: Thirty tasks fail under the predeclared scoring paths, including five safety-critical tasks. Digital communication, emergency safety, shopping/payment, and finance/banking are the most concentrated failure areas.
interpretation.next_research_gate: Analyze failures in a separate operation. Do not alter this battery or result.
